purpose: Version-specific discovery catalog for Vintage Story 1.22.6 reference material.
notes: This is the only retained Vintage Story reference version. It has decompiled built-in API sources for VintagestoryAPI, VintagestoryLib, VSCreativeMod, VSEssentials, and VSSurvivalMod, copied full client assets, selected reference mods and tools, copied curated web sources, a code index, an asset index, and a web index.

Betterer Prospecting 3.4.5, Primitive Survival 5.1.0, RPVoiceChat 2.5.8, and TentBag-Reworked 3.2.4 had exact Mod DB 1.22.6 releases. The other selected mods use the newest same-line 1.22.x release as a documented fallback; see .codex/tmp/mod-updates/1.22.6/selected-releases.json for the release evidence.

Simple VS Manager 2.3.0 was added as a Mod DB external-tool reference for mod-manager workflow research. It is not a normal game mod package, has no modinfo.json, and is documented at versions/1.22.6/mods/simplevsmanager_2.3.0/REFERENCE_SOURCE.md.
Curated web sources were copied forward from earlier curated manifests and re-indexed for 1.22.6.
Generated index manifests remain the source of truth for exact generated-at timestamps, roots, and detailed counts.
Query indexes before opening raw files.
